title: MAKE BELIEVE
synopsis: In 1991, a young boy discovers a mysterious viewer that transports him into worlds shaped by his imagination. From dragons and pirates to distant galaxies, his adventures become increasingly dangerous as fantasy begins to take on a life of its own.

audienceReactions.quote: Outstanding work. I've watched 100s of AI shorts, and this is one of the first that made me nearly forget it was AI.
audienceReactions.author: @HarveyCreative

audienceReactions.quote: Wow, people underestimate how much work goes into telling good stories even while using AI for video generation. Congratulations to whole team who worked on this.
audienceReactions.author: @NirdeshakRao

audienceReactions.quote: There's just something about how the AI does the vocal inflections that seems the same across these higgsfield shorts. I liked the story.
audienceReactions.author: @twosuns20
